cards.title: Who we are?
cards.text: Rural Bank of Paete Inc. is a proud community-based bank committed to delivering reliable, affordable, and inclusive financial services to individuals, farmers, fisherfolk, and micro-entrepreneurs in Laguna and neighboring areas.

cards.title: Our Story
cards.text: Founded in 1966 our bank has been a pillar of strength for the local economy. We are passionate about empowering our clients, whether it's helping you start your savings journey or funding your farm or small business.

missionVisionIntro.title: Our Mission and Vision Statement
missionVisionIntro.class: bg-[#00aeef] text-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-md self-start
missionVisionIntro.text: Our mission and vision guide our purpose and direction, ensuring every service we provide stays true to our values and long-term goals for the community.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: To promote financial inclusion and growth in rural communities by providing safe, simple, and sustainable banking solutions.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To be the most trusted and accessible rural bank in Laguna and Southern Luzon, driven by integrity, innovation, and community care.
